verdict.rationale: Mastra is a framework, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence only says developers can build their own MCP servers with Mastra, which is a building block rather than a first-party MCP server. The MCP-tasks blog and the community note about the stdio-only MCP client concern other capabilities, and no official Mastra-hosted or packaged MCP server is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
